text:
Alex: heads up — found a billing/telemetry skew: projectless API keys in sandbox are showing up as the org default project in the console, which inflates that project's token usage. noticed this in the weekly quota report :eyes:
Sam: yup saw that too earlier. root cause looks like router fallback: if no project claim, gateway attaches org.default_project as `effective_project` for routing. simplifies routing but breaks attribution in dashboards.
Riley: that fallback was intentional for routing QoS, but we never emitted a separate telemetry tag for asserted vs effective project. we should add `project.asserted` and `project.effective` in logs/metrics. minimal change.
Jen: warning — if we start surfacing asserted vs effective, we need to ensure we don't leak internal org ids to tenants. also impersonation risk if proxy blindly trusts headers. signed exchange only.
Alex: agree on signing. current oauth token exchange path strips project claim for delegated SA tokens, so asserted project is missing downstream. when gateway falls back we lose provenance.
Sam: short-term patch: in auth-service, when exchanging service account tokens, set an explicit `x-asserted-project` header (signed) for the gateway. gateway keeps `x-effective-project` for routing. telemetry emits both.
Chris: for console UX, let's show an "Attribution confidence" column: HIGH when asserted present, FALLBACK when only effective. add a checkbox filter to include/exclude FALLBACK attribution. helps cost owners triage.
Riley: implementation sketch for router check:
```
if (header('x-asserted-project')) {
  effective = header('x-asserted-project')
  attribution_reason = 'asserted'
} else if (token.claims.project) {
  effective = token.claims.project
  attribution_reason = 'token_claim'
} else {
  effective = org.default_project
  attribution_reason = 'fallback'
}
emitMetric('request.attribution', {effective, attribution_reason, org})
```
Sam: we should also emit `attribution_confidence` as numeric (2=asserted,1=token_claim,0=fallback) so dashboard can aggregate easily.
Jen: how do we prevent people from forging x-asserted-project? either gateway verifies signature from auth-service or we only allow internal header if coming from trusted subnet. prefer signed claim.
Alex: signed JWT header with `iss=auth-service` and min 3s ttl should be fine. the gateway will reject unsigned or invalid signatures.
Chris: rollout proposal: feature flag `project_attribution_v2`. enable in staging, then canary 5% orgs next Tuesday, collect delta on per-project reported usage and on billing pipelines. telemetry events we want: `attribution_changed` (old->new), `attribution_confidence_delta`, `console_filter_usage`.
Sam: also add backfill job in metrics pipeline to recompute last 7 days for orgs in canary so billing UI matches historicals during test.
Alex: ops note: quota enforcement must continue to use effective routing value for SLOs; we just change only the billing/visibility tags. enforcement path unchanged.
Riley: small perf note — adding extra header verification and telemetry tags is cheap (1-2ms) but batching codepaths should avoid per-request crypto where possible. auth-service should sign short-lived JWTs in batches or use mTLS between services.
Jen: security thumbs up if signed and audited. add a quick checklist to PR template: (1) header signed, (2) gateway verification, (3) telemetry fields documented, (4) no user-visible PII.
Alex: deploy-bot — please enable `project_attribution_v2` in staging and run canary smoke where we hit projectless keys.
deploy-bot: project_attribution_v2 flag turned ON in staging :white_check_mark: — smoke tests queued.
Sam: after staging smoke, I'll open a rollout RFC with telemetry dashboards attached. cc @chris for UI mocks.
Chris: I'll prototype the attribution confidence column and the filter. mock will be ready by EOD Friday.
Alex: action items:
- Sam: RFC + telemetry dashboards + backfill job plan
- Riley: router + gateway changes + perf note (mTLS or batching signing)
- Jen: security checklist + signature spec
- Chris: console mock + filter behavior
- Alex: run a liason with billing to validate downstream pipelines
Alex: aim to canary 5% next Tue, full rollout after 2 weeks of metrics sanity. thanks all :ship:
